entry.title: Cross-Subject EEG-fNIRS Fusion via Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
entry.summary: We propose a self-supervised framework for fusing EEG and fNIRS signals to improve cross-subject generalization in brain-computer interfaces. Our approach uses contrastive pretraining on unlabeled multimodal recordings before fine-tuning on downstream motor imagery classification.

entry.title: Parameterized Quantum Circuits for Attention Mechanisms in EEG Seizure Detection
entry.summary: This work explores replacing classical dot-product self-attention with a parameterized quantum circuit within a transformer encoder for epileptic seizure detection from EEG, evaluated on CHB-MIT and TUH corpora.
